messages:
maria: FYI, I submitted a reserved capacity commitment for us-west-2 (resv-3492) at 2024-11-12 09:02 PT. Billing shows the commit active and charged, but the GPU pool still shows no new slots and the request is at priority queue position 12. Any idea why it's not fulfilling? :eyes:
aj: can you paste the reservation id + requested shape/qty? i'll check the provisioner.
maria: resv-3492
shape: a100-80gb
qty: 4
term: 1yr
submitted via infra-cli: `ri reserve --region us-west-2 --shape a100-80gb --qty 4 --term 12m`
ops-bot: reservation resv-3492: billing status = CHARGED, provisioning status = PENDING_ALLOC (queue_pos=12). ETA unknown.
kevin: we've been seeing a lead time spike in usw2 due to fleet maintenance and a failed GPU node delivery. current target backfill is end of week but that was optimistic. tickets: CLST-8723.
sarah: Finance sees the charge on invoice INV-2024-11-12 - we need a reconciliation note if capacity isn't available. Can infra file a chargeback/credit request? :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
aj: looking at the scheduling logs, resv-3492 attempted to fit into pool a100-usw2-prod but failed packing because of fragmentation. There's smaller reserved workloads pinned to nodes. Suggest either allow cross-pool placement to a100-usw2-burst or consolidate small reservations.
maria: cross-pool placement was disabled for this customer (policy: no-burst). This is an enterprise customer with dedicated constraints.
kevin: two options: 1) Make an exception and move 4 small spotless reservations -> consolidate to free 4 GPUs (manual reassign, ~2h ops), 2) issue refund/credit and schedule resv for next available capacity window. Which do we want?
sarah: Customer billing team prefers credits over surprises. If it's quicker to reassign, keep them happy and avoid crediting. But we need a formal approval from product/risk for policy exception.
aj: @sarah i'll draft a short ops-runbook for the manual reassign and list rollback steps. @maria can you ping the customer that we're investigating and we'll update within 3 business hours?
maria: pinged the customer (acct: acme-data) — told them we're investigating and will confirm ETA in 3h. Also requested permission to apply cross-pool placement if needed.
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4867 for credit holdback request (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-4867).
kevin: I'll start the manual reassign in ~30m if product approves. tagging @product-lead for exception sign-off.
sarah: I'll hold on credits until we see ops outcome. If manual reassign fails or takes >6h, finance will request pro-rata credit for the unused period.
